portals.name: Back up: The Lantern Row Cache

interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The four keys
interactives.text: The deposit of the four keys keeps a copy of every account. What is made under it is entered twice and counts double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The stormglass house's under-room. Books read three times as fast.

interactives.label: The city
interactives.text: Four gates, four roads: north to Mirrorhold, east to the Sunmane Steppe, south to the Ssarathi Ruins, west across the causeway to Crownwater.

interactives.label: The ledger
interactives.text: Everything that walks through a gate is counted. Everything that rolls is weighed. Where the two disagree is where someone is standing.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The beacon
interactives.text: The sanctuary beacon was lit for a ship that never came. It is still lit.

interactives.label: The ninety candles
interactives.text: Ninety candles were set for ninety names. One is still burning; nobody will say whose.

interactives.label: The crossings
interactives.text: Every road out of the city is a causeway or a stair, because the city is an island that decided not to be.

interactives.label: The Sanctuary Reliquary
interactives.text: Under the northern sanctuary, opened with an iron rune.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Storage
interactives.text: The civic chest, every wayfarer's cache and every secret's chest open the same storage.

sections.name: The Sunleaf Hollow
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: A dry cistern under the east quarter where sunleaf grows toward a grating.

sections.name: The Reedworks Garden
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: Beds under the reedworks where the weavers grow their own.

sections.name: The Lantern Row Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A cellar off Lantern Row: chest, bench and the quartz the lamp-makers keep.

sections.name: The Deposit Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The bank's own strongroom, under the deposit of the four keys.

sections.name: The Otter Pit
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: A flooded cellar off the south-east quay where the watch trains against otters.

sections.name: The Stormglass School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the stormglass house teaches its apprentices.

sections.name: The Plaza Spring
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the plaza a warm spring the civic monument was built over.

sections.name: The Ferryman's Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the ferryman's rest with stags at the far end.

sections.name: The Sanctuary Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Under the northern sanctuary, opened with an iron rune.

sections.name: The Mirrorsmith's Well
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: The forge's cistern drinks every spell; the stags penned there are practice.

sections.name: The Civic Focus
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the civic monument the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Gates Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Four stones under the south avenue. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Wall Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket in the east wall's footing.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 13 secrets of Four Gates Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
